stories.title: Installed app cards expose the complete operations path
App detail becomes the canonical operations center
Backup history and first-backup prompts are visible where decisions happen
Failed jobs can be rerun from the UI
Backup destination risk is visible before launch

featureSequence.summary: Make Open, Details, Backup, Restore, and failed-job rerun discoverable.
Show real runtime/readiness state and notify on critical failures.
Add server-enforced admin unlock before destructive host/app actions.
Plan, execute, verify, and repair the recommended Tailscale Serve topology.
Make local-only backup risk visible and add an off-host backup destination path.

featureSequence.featureName: Guided Setup and First Backup Wizard
featureSequence.summary: Guide a founder through setup, publishing, app install, and first backup.
Require pre-update backups, health-gate updates, and offer honest rollback.

launchDefinition.name: founder-confidence launch
launchDefinition.description: Eric can run his own household apps through Homebase and use Homebase instead of routine shell work for normal operations.
gates: Routine app operations are discoverable: open, backup, restore, rerun failed jobs.
App health/readiness and critical failures are visible and can alert the founder.
Destructive operations require Homebase admin authorization.
Private Tailscale service publishing is managed or clearly verified by Homebase.
Backups are not silently local-only and an off-host backup destination path is addressed.
Setup leads to at least one installed, reachable, backed-up app.
App updates require backup and have honest rollback semantics.
Homebase can distinguish installed apps from ready apps for enough of the suite to operate confidently.

branchAndPrPolicy.reviewExpectation: Each feature lands through a PR with tests, VM/browser evidence where relevant, and founder plus agent/code-review notes before merge.
branchAndPrPolicy.mergeExpectation: Prefer squash or merge commits with commit trailers recording constraints, rejected alternatives, confidence, scope risk, tested, and not-tested evidence.
